label.en: Everything turns to dust. The rest is merely prelude.

label.zh: 让我们来教教他们科学吧。
label.en: Let's educate them in the sciences.

label.en: Everything turns to dust. The rest is merely prelude.

texts.zh: 我们正在见证[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
texts.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power to capture the spiritual striving of their society. They yearn for something beyond themselves to believe in.

label.zh: 我们应当回应他们的祈祷！
一切都将化为尘土。剩下的只不过是这件事的序曲。
label.en: Everything turns to dust. The rest is merely prelude.

texts.zh: 通过向存在的神圣真理开放自己，[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民正在接近开悟。作为精神领袖，我们有责任引导他们。
texts.en: By opening themselves to the divine truth of existence, the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] are approaching enlightenment. As spiritual leaders, it is our duty to guide them.

texts.zh: 当[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民仰望天空时，他们希望得到圣灵的赐福。然而，他们实际得到的是沉默。他们的祈祷没有得到回应。现在他们必须接受精神飘忽不定的本质。只有科学拥有他们寻求的答案。
texts.en: When the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] looked up to the skies they hoped to receive blessings from the divine. What they actually received was silence. Their prayers have gone unanswered. Now they must accept the frivolous nature of spirituality. Only science holds the answers they seek.

texts.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民已经开始提出一个理论，认为他们的所在的星球是由一个不可言喻的存在赠送给他们的，而生命是对神圣造物主不屈不挠的奉献所进行的回报。或许当他们遇到更广泛的星海共同体时，他们会有一个惊喜。
texts.en: The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have begun to theorize that their world was gifted to them by an ineffable being, and that life is a reward for unyielding devotion to a divine creator. They may be in for a surprise when the time comes for them to meet the wider galactic community.

label.zh: 让我们来教教他们科学吧。
label.en: Let's educate them in the sciences.

label.zh: 假以时日，他们的信仰会发展。
label.en: Their faith will develop, given time.

texts.zh:
通过向[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的唯心领袖们现身，我们告诉他们所谓的“神圣造物主”并不存在。他们想要的答案只有通过科学才能找到。

不幸的是，我们的这堂课没有起到效果。这些人们将我们视为神明，整日向我们三叩九拜。我们的任务起到了反效果。
texts.en:
Revealing ourselves to the would-be spiritual leaders on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], we assured them that their so-called 'divine creator' does not exist. The answers they seek can be found only through science.

Unfortunately, our lessons have been ignored. The people now look to us as as gods, vowing to worship us for all time. Our mission has backfired.

label.zh: 这件事本来能够做得更好。

texts.zh:
他们生气了！我们的行动彻底地惹恼了[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民。数个世纪以来，他们社会中的成员经常在神秘的情况下失踪，然后又在数日或数月后出现，口述着难以置信的外星科技的故事，这一切在他们眼里无异于魔法。

可以理解，发现魔法不存在，这一切仅仅是外星人们为了研究你们的所作所为这件事极大地撼动了他们的世界观。人们在一夜之间倒向孤立主义，礼貌地要求我们不要再把他们当成实验对象。也许我们是该考虑他们的请求。
texts.en:
They are furious! Our actions have completely embarrassed the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]. For centuries, members of their society have disappeared under mysterious circumstances, only to reappear days or months later with the most incredible stories of alien technology, which from their perspective is nothing short of magical.

Understandably, learning that magic isn't real - but aliens who probe you for research purposes are - has somewhat shaken their worldview. The population has become an insular society overnight, and are politely requesting us to stop treating them as lab specimens. Perhaps we should consider their request.
